Guides / Hunting / Trainer ranks

Trainer ranks

The 12 ranks: species needed, base Shiny and Perfect odds, and spawn weights.

Your rank rises with the number of species in your Pokédex (Mega forms don't count). Higher ranks bring better Shiny / Void / Prismatic and Perfect-IV odds, rarer spawns, and unlock better balls at the Mart. Odds below are before the Shiny Charm.

RankSpeciesShinyVoidPrismaticPerfect IVsCommon / Uncommon / Rare / Legendary weightPerk
Rookie01 in 2,4001 in 7,2001 in 19,2001 in 1,00080 / 20 / 0 / 0Poké Balls and the common grass Pokémon
Youngster51 in 2,1601 in 6,4801 in 17,2801 in 88074 / 24 / 2 / 0Rare Pokémon start to appear
Bug Catcher121 in 1,9201 in 5,7601 in 15,3601 in 80066 / 28 / 6 / 0Great Balls at the Mart
Camper251 in 1,6801 in 5,0401 in 13,4401 in 72060 / 30 / 10 / 0More uncommon and rare Pokémon
Ace Trainer401 in 1,4401 in 4,3201 in 11,5201 in 64055 / 31 / 13 / 1Ultra Balls, and legendaries roam the islands you have beaten
Gym Leader701 in 1,3201 in 3,9601 in 10,5601 in 60050 / 32 / 16 / 1Better shiny odds
Elite Four1101 in 1,2601 in 3,7801 in 10,0801 in 58045 / 33 / 19 / 1.5Better shiny odds
Champion1701 in 1,2001 in 3,6001 in 9,6001 in 56040 / 34 / 22 / 2Better shiny odds
Hall of Famer2601 in 1,1401 in 3,4201 in 9,1201 in 54038 / 34 / 23 / 3More legendaries roam the grass

Living Dex10491 in 8401 in 2,5201 in 6,7201 in 44030 / 34 / 27 / 4Every Pokémon caught. The best shiny odds

The legendary weight only counts on islands whose Gym you've beaten once you hold 3 badges, and it's ×0.33 of what's listed (a beaten island always has at least 0.5 × 0.33). Mythicals never appear in the wild.

The Living Dex rank needs every species except the 23 Mythicals (they come only from Raids).
